'''Lud Chud''' was a [[Rakaan]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Crime lord/Legends|boss]] who settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]]. Lud had influence, property and henchmen throughout the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] but it concentrated its activities on Torina, [[Lanthrym]] and [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. At these sites Lud engaged in loansharking, protection rackets, black marketing, forgery and smuggling. Only few [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] had seen Lud, it allowed others to circulate the misperception that it was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Lud was rivals with [[Kaggle|Boss Kaggle]]. Lud also constructed and oversaw the illegal [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Smugglers' Strip]] on Elrood.
